source.title: Top Things to do in Myeongdong 2026

hooks: Says Lotte Department Store 'needs no introduction' to K-drama watchers (source article)
Prefers Shinsegae's quieter food court and recommends single-brand K-beauty stores for better freebies (source article)
Picks kal-guksu over dumplings at Michelin-listed Myeongdong Kyoja (source article)

list.title: Myeongdong: K-beauty, shopping & food, from A Love Letter to Asia
list.desc: Places from A Love Letter to Asia's 'Top Things to do in Myeongdong 2026' (https://alovelettertoasia.com/top-things-to-do-in-myeongdong/). Collected by PinWith, not made by A Love Letter to Asia.

items.title: Lotte Department Store Main (롯데백화점 본점)
items.memo: Famous to K-drama fans; supermarket, food court, duty-free, linked hotel.

items.title: Shinsegae Main Store (신세계백화점 본점)
items.memo: Author's pick for a quieter, better food court and luxury brands.

items.title: Olive Young Myeongdong (올리브영 명동)
items.memo: Huge Olive Young store with many brands, though fewer samples.
items.check: article says 'biggest store' without address; matched to Myeongdong Town flagship

items.title: 3CE Pink Space Hotel (Stylenanda)
items.memo: Pink hotel-themed shop for trendy makeup and clothes; photo-friendly.
items.check: article calls it 'Stylenada Pink Hotel Cafe'; Google lists it as 3CE Pink Space Hotel

items.title: Noon Square (눈스퀘어)
items.memo: Mall the article suggests for affordable international brands.

items.title: Myeongdong Kyoja (명동교자)
items.memo: Michelin-listed; author prefers the kal-guksu. Cold noodles are very spicy.

items.title: Hadongkwan (하동관)
items.memo: Gomtang since 1939; closes mid-afternoon, so go early.

items.title: Myeongdong Cathedral (명동성당)
items.memo: 1898 Gothic church; English Mass on Sundays, lit up at Christmas.

items.title: Myeongdong NANTA Theatre
items.memo: Non-verbal kitchen-drumming comedy show running since 1997.

items.title: Namsangol Hanok Village (남산골한옥마을)
items.memo: Traditional hanok village a short trip from Myeongdong.
